page.title: System
page.description: Installation health, job queues, recent failures, version and migrations. Visible only to installation administrators, with no business data.

forbidden.title: Restricted area
forbidden.description: This area requires the manage system permission.
forbidden.twoFactor: Turn on two-step verification to access this area.

reasons.unavailable: Could not write a probe file.
reasons.heartbeat_stale: The last worker heartbeat is late.
reasons.backlog_delayed: Ready jobs are waiting longer than the limit.
reasons.disabled: This check is turned off for this installation.

workers.title: Workers
workers.empty: No active worker. Run `aphel worker` or `aphel serve --with-worker`.

queue.title: Job queue
queue.oldest: Oldest ready job has been waiting for {{age}}.

failedJobs.title: Failed jobs
failedJobs.description: Jobs that exhausted their attempts. Retrying resets the attempts and puts the job back in the queue; discarding deletes it. Both actions are recorded.
failedJobs.retried: Job put back in the queue.
failedJobs.discardDescription: The {{kind}} job will be deleted and will not run again.

failures.title: Recent failures
failures.description: Last {{days}} days. Metadata only: kind, error and date.

migrations.title: Migrations
migrations.pending: {{count}} pending migration(s). Run `aphel upgrade` with a recent backup.

modules.title: Compiled modules
modules.empty: No module is compiled into this binary.
